alex: quick follow-up from today's all-hands on spend controls — two things: 1) new approval thresholds? 2) what's the fastest path for a time-sensitive infra purchase that will unblock a customer demo? cc @camille @rahul

camille (CFO): TL;DR: runway is healthy but we are tightening discretionary spend. approval bands now: <$3k manager ok, $3k-$25k procurement+finance, $25k-$250k senior finance sign-off, >$250k CFO+legal.

alex: got it. p-cards?

camille (CFO): p-card single txn cap remains $3k, rolling monthly $12k. p-cards can't be used for vendor onboarding fees >$3k. exceptions via Spend Request with two approvers.

rahul (procurement): for urgent infra (customer-facing) — tag Spend Request "expedite-demo" and ping @rahul. we can issue temporary PO or approve p-card exception up to $10k while onboarding completes. include customer impact and ETA.

maria: who signs off if it's $18k and urgent?

camille (CFO): $18k needs procurement + finance approval; use expedite tag and we'll prioritize; CFO only if >$25k. aim is 48-hr turnaround for validated demos.

alex: perfect, thanks. I'll file the request now.
